**King's Question — Archmage Testimony**

(1) **No leylijn or Kroonklok disturbance on day 9–10 or day 22 in my source.** My measurements occur only on days 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42 (ARC-001–ARC-084). Day 9–10 and day 22 have no measurements. The nearest are day 7 (all nominal, ARC-001–ARC-014), day 14 (all fourteen lines low, ARC-015–ARC-028), day 21 (all nominal, ARC-029–ARC-042). Letters: ARC-107 (dag 9) notes lamp oil delivery, a sticking door latch, two broken lantern glasses — no leylijn hapering. ARC-108 (dag 12) reports a snapped staff at the Dallijn on dag 11. ARC-104 (dag 5) records the annual Kroonklok stemming: “geen afwijking; er hoefde niets bijgesteld te worden.” No Kroonklok tick data or timestamps exist in my source.

(2) **No record labelled “magical desync” in my source.** The only deviations are the league-wide low readings on day 14 (sterkte 3.1–4.6, ARC-015–ARC-028) and day 42 (sterkte 3.1–4.8, ARC-071–ARC-084). ARC-109 (dag 15) and ARC-116 (dag 42) attribute both episodes to the datanet. ARC-114 (dag 35) confirms the Burchtader was “kalm, zonder enige hapering” during the Wachtsterren conjunctie (nacht van dag 33).

(3) **I hold no Kroonklok tick record (GUA-103) nor pols-timestamp rules (HIS-103, HIS-110).** Those belong to other offices. My only Kroonklok reference is ARC-104 (dag 5), which states the annual stemming found no deviation. I cannot match or contradict ENG-011 (02:40 hulpslag) or ENG-026 (04:15 packet loss) because I have no clock-tick or timestamp rules in my source.

---

**How it works**  
- Leylijnwacht measures all fourteen lines before dawn on a fixed ~7-day cadence (ARC-105, ARC-109, ARC-116).  
- Each line read with an essenhout staff and meetkristal; readings recorded as sterkte (ARC-001–ARC-084).  
- Kroonklok stemming performed yearly by klokkenmeester per oude voorschriften; Archmage co-signs (ARC-104).  
- Datanet signals judged to “vervuilen de leylijnen”; Archmage advises full shutdown (ARC-109, ARC-112, ARC-116).  
- Stellar conjunctions monitored via Sterrenwacht; Burchtader walked during conjunction night (ARC-111, ARC-114).

**Sequence & anomalies**  
- Dag 7: all 14 lines nominal (7.0–8.7), ARC-001–ARC-014.  
- Dag 14: all 14 lines low (3.1–4.6), repeated measurements, Burchtader “stokte even,” ARC-015–ARC-028; ARC-109 warns datanet.  
- Dag 21: all 14 lines nominal (7.0–8.5), ARC-029–ARC-042.  
- Dag 28: all 14 lines nominal (7.0–8.6), ARC-043–ARC-056; ARC-113 notes Moerasader crystal minor scratch.  
- Dag 33 nacht: Wachtsterren conjunctie; Burchtader “kalm, zonder enige hapering,” ARC-114.  
- Dag 35: all 14 lines nominal (7.1–8.7), ARC-057–ARC-070.  
- Dag 42: all 14 lines low again (3.1–4.8), repeated measurements, ARC-071–ARC-084; ARC-116 repeats shutdown demand.

**Recovery & constraints**  
- Staff must be essenhout, dried, straight-grained; pine rejected (ARC-110).  
- Crystals re-faceted by Gilde; payment 40 zilver for 14 (ARC-103, ARC-113).  
- Signal-mast lamp dimmed midnight–dawn to avoid crystal glare (ARC-102, ARC-106).  
- Door latch repaired by smith (ARC-107, ARC-115).  
- Apprentice leave granted; rounds covered (ARC-108).  
- Safety: “Wie daaraan twijfelt, heeft nooit een staf in de hand gehad” (ARC-109); council bears responsibility while datanet runs (ARC-116).

**Unasked findings**  
- ARC-111 (dag 20): Sterrenwacht confirms next conjunction dag 33; no other celestial anomalies.  
- ARC-108 (dag 12): Apprentice’s staff snapped at Dallijn on dag 11 (“gisteren”) — mechanical failure, not leylijn.  
- ARC-115 (dag 38): Quartermaster delivers 12 new essenhout staves, 2 sand bags, 6 lantern glasses, lamp oil; door latch finally fixed.
